dialogues.speaker: Fangjin
dialogues.text: So you're taking the initiative to attack the Domain at the disturbance... May your victory be swift!

dialogues.speaker: Fangjin
dialogues.text: The situation is stable for now. The Ley Line Disturbance is becalmed, and our forces are clearing out the monsters that escaped.

choices.text: What can you tell me about the Ley Line disturbance?

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: As you can see, the site has changed quite a bit since we first observed it. We've strengthened reconnaissance and deployed extra reserves in response...

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Fortunately, based on our scouting reports, the threat is contained — for the time being.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Though even at peak activity, I'm confident we can hold the line.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Of course, I'm sure you'll be able to weaken its momentum and keep any further anomalies in check.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Please rest assured that our troops are currently well-equipped and rested. Our forces are extremely resilient — we could stay here for the long haul and still fight at full strength if it came to that.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Under the Kaiyang's masterful command, our vanguard is rotated every two weeks to keep from overworking any of our men.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Right now, the frontlines are already stable, and the rotating shifts consist of seven veterans for every three fresh recruits.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: That way, we can deal with the threat while also exposing our recruits to an environment conducive for training.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Of course, no matter how personnel are shifted, my trusted subordinates and I will be stationed here to assist you. Rest assured.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: But of course. This is my duty as a proud soldier of the Millelith!

dialogues.speaker: Fangjin
dialogues.text: I have both bad news and good news... which do you want to hear first?

choices.text: Let's get the bad news out of the way.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: As you can see, the Ley Line disturbance has become active again. Compared to its initial state, it now looks far more menacing — though it's really just appearances.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Vicious monsters have already begun to stir. Before you arrived, we repelled several waves of their attacks already.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Once more, we need your help to delve into the depths of the Domain.

choices.text: Of course. Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: An imposing manner indeed... I'm sure you'll do just as well this time!

choices.text: Give me a minute to prep, I'll be right back.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Of course, don't rush. In the meantime, we'll handle any monsters that escape.

choices.text: Let's hear the good news first.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Thanks to the reactivation of the Ley Line disturbances, our troops are warming up for this new, challenging combat exercise.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Previously, our fellow Millelith had already purged the most dangerous monsters from across Liyue, leaving our ordinary troops with little chance to face truly formidable foes.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: If we let them languish in this safe environment for too long, their minds and bodies will only grow dull. A real battle like this is a perfect opportunity for them to reflect upon their training.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: So even as we ensure the integrity of our defenses and handle the threats, we are constantly sharpening ourselves through this Ley Line disturbance.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Thanks to the recent battles, many of our soldiers have shown remarkable improvement — I believe we'll see even more outstanding fighters emerge in the days to come!

choices.text: Let me think about it, and I'll get back to you.

response.speaker: Fangjin
response.text: Alright, I'll be here waiting.
